== Summary ==
Only surviving copy (thumbnail, 50×38). Decipher's caption: "Paul Mammini of California was also a Star Trek CCG World finalist at the '97 tournament in Las Vegas." Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
